sources.snippet: In-laws charged with murder of New York Times games engineer in California  The Guardian
sources.title: In-laws charged with murder of New York Times games engineer in California - The Guardian

sources.snippet:
Shili Chen and Shouyong Zhang, both 77, charged days before Jonathan McKinsey and wife were set for hearing in divorce case

A California couple have been charged with murder after authorities say they shot their son-in-law to death on Saturday in a public park, days before he and the couple’s daughter were set for a hearing in a bitter divorce case.

Shili Chen and Shouyong Zhang, both 77, were due in court on Wednesday for an arraignment on the charges. The Associated Press was not able to reach an attorney for the couple before the court appearance. Their daughter, Candice Jang, could not be reached, though she appeared virtually at Wednesday’s hearing.

sources.snippet: Jetzt ist es entschieden: Nach dem F-47 für die US-Luftwaffe baut Boeing auch den neuen Navy-Fighter. Damit liegen beide Superjet-Programme bei einem Konzern mit Milliardenverlusten und Verzögerungen. Diese Entscheidung offenbart den strategischen Druck, unter dem Washington steht.

sources.snippet: Das Deutschlandticket wird erneut teurer. Es kostet ab Januar 66,80 Euro und damit 3,80 Euro mehr als bisher. An der neuen Preissteigerung gab es vorab schon deutliche Kritik von Fahrgast- und Umweltverbänden.

sources.snippet: A taxa de variação homóloga do Índice de Preços no Consumidor (IPC) terá aumentado para 3,6% em setembro de 2026, taxa superior em 0,3 pontos percentuais (p.p.) à observada no mês anterior, refere o INE. A culpa é, em grande medida, do aumento do preço dos combustíveis.
